title: Permanent peer rejections (4xx/invalidArguments) retry 72x instead of immediate mark_failed
description: outbox_tick: when deliver() returns PeerRejected or HttpError(4xx), record_failure is called, scheduling exponential-backoff retries. A message rejected with invalidArguments (bad bodyType, oversized body, ULID mismatch) will never succeed yet retries 72 times over hours before permanent failure. Trigger: peer rejects delivery with a 4xx HTTP status or a JMAP invalidArguments response. Fix: check error type — PeerRejected(invalidArguments/notFound) and HttpError(4xx) should call mark_failed immediately.
